violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes on cheese and other food items stored directly on the floor in the walk in cooler.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Scoop handle was observed to be laying down in pizza dough breading not handle up.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor, walls and ceiling was observed to have dust, food build up and grease. Needs to be cleaned more frequent.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Employee did not wash hands before putting on gloves.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Cold hold unit needs door repaired.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. Hot hold and cold hold units need a cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor, walls and ceiling need cleaning . Back of equipment floors need cleaning.
Provided as required, designed, constructed, installed, maintained, and cleaned (1 pt deducted)
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
